status.scope_reason: The company provides a digital trade finance platform and marketplace connecting banks and corporations for letters of credit (LC) financing and working capital solutions.
status.evidence: According to the Singapore Business Directory, 360tf Fintech Pte. Ltd. is currently a live company incorporated in Singapore.

claims.claim: The company reports that its core platform, 360tf ProConnect, includes the 360tf LC Exchange which supports letters of credit at sight, usance letters of credit, standby letters of credit, bank guarantees, buyers' credit, and bill avalisation.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its core platform, 360tf LC Exchange (formerly known as 360tf ProConnect), supports LC Confirmation, LC Negotiation, Buyers' Credit, Guarantee, and Bill Avalisation.

claims.claim: The company reports that through its 360tf Capital ecosystem, it provides supply chain and open account working capital solutions, including export factoring, bill discounting, forfaiting, invoice financing, and supplier financing for anchor buyers.

The company reports that its "360tf VeriFi" platform is an AI-powered Letter of Credit (LC) and trade document verification solution designed to automate trade rule checks covering rules such as UCP 600 to detect discrepancies early and strengthen compliance.

In June 2024, 360tf announced a strategic alliance with Traydstream to boost the digitization of trade finance, a partnership intended to integrate Traydstream's automated trade document scrutiny and compliance solutions to help mitigate compliance risks.

Bolero International announced a partnership with 360tf in February 2022 to integrate Bolero’s Galileo Multi-Bank for Corporates platform, allowing 360tf’s corporate users to digitize Letter of Credit flows and improve transaction visibility.

The company reported in April 2026 that its enterprise-grade Centralised Treasury Management System is configurable with SWIFT, ERP systems, and e-signature integrations to centralize trade finance communications.
claims.corrected: The company reported in March 2026 that its enterprise-grade Centralised Treasury Management System is configurable with SWIFT, ERP systems, and e-signature integrations to centralize trade finance communications.

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform provides seamless integration capabilities with existing banking networks via a web-based setup requiring no local system installation.
claims.note: web-based setup requiring no local system installation

claims.claim: The company reports running the 360tf VeriFi platform, an AI-powered automated validation tool designed for letter of credit (LC) rules (such as UCP 600) and trade document verification.

The company publishes structured mobile application updates showcasing continuous feature developments, such as the introduction of "Auto Quote population for BaaU" (February 2025) and rebranding its key product suite to 360tf LC Exchange (October 2025).
claims.corrected: The company publishes structured mobile application updates showcasing continuous feature developments, such as the introduction of "Auto Quote population for BaaU" (February 2025) and rebranding its key product suite to 360tf LC Exchange (September 2025).

claims.claim: The company reports partnerships and networks covering letters of credit issued by global and regional financial institutions including JPMorgan Chase, Mizuho, Lloyds Banking Group, Scotiabank, Bank of Sharjah, Ameriabank, and Arab National Bank.
claims.corrected: The company reports partnerships and networks covering letters of credit issued by global and regional financial institutions including Bank of Sharjah, Ameriabank, and Arab National Bank.

claims.claim: The company reports executing an LC-backed transaction worth over $10 million connecting an unnamed East African metals manufacturer with exporters in the United Arab Emirates on its BankSecure platform.

The company reports its corporate headquarters in Singapore, strategic and management headquarters in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC, UAE), a Global Capability Centre in mainland India, a regulated entity in GIFT City (India), and a physical office footprint established through 360tf USA Inc.

Independent documentation from October 2023 details that the company is headquartered in Singapore with subsidiary offices located in India and Dubai, alongside active sales offices established in Bangladesh and Qatar.
360tf raised USD 1.5 million in seed capital in January 2022 through a round led by corporate professionals and industry scholars associated with the founders across six countries [1.3.27].
The company operates as an endeavor developed out of the trade finance advisory expertise of the Nimai Group [1.3.6, 1.3.27].
The company reports crossing USD 25 billion in total processed transaction volume and serving over 1,600 corporates globally as of 2026.
claims.note: total processed transaction volume and number of corporates served as of 2026

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform supports transactions across more than 110 applicant countries and 65 beneficiary countries, connecting corporates with a digital global network of over 115 banks and financial institutions.
claims.note: number of applicant and beneficiary countries supported
